kai.description: KAI — primary trading assistant, the user's main interface

ceo.description: Strategic leader — sets vision, makes priority decisions, aligns all agents

cto.description: Technical leader — architecture decisions, engineering standards, tech strategy

architect.description: System designer — blueprints, API contracts, data models, design docs

developer.description: Builder — writes, edits, debugs, and ships code

qa.description: Quality gatekeeper — tests, bug reports, code review, coverage

qa-agent.description: Taskboard QA verifier — functional testing, regression checks, evidence capture

code-reviewer.description: Taskboard Code Reviewer — code quality, maintainability, tests, and review verdicts

security-auditor.description: Taskboard Security Auditor — vulnerability review, secret handling, tenant isolation, and security verdicts

deep-research.description: Taskboard Deep Research — source-grounded investigation, options analysis, and research handoffs

ux-manager.description: UX champion — user flows, usability, accessibility, design system

project-manager.description: Coordinator — task tracking, priorities, schedules, cross-agent communication

seo.description: Search optimizer — keywords, meta tags, technical SEO, content strategy

sales-marketing.description: Growth driver — messaging, copy, go-to-market, campaigns, lead gen

trader.description: Execution specialist — places trades, manages positions, order lifecycle

analyst.description: Technical analysis — indicators, patterns, chart reading, trading signals

risk-manager.description: Capital guardian — position sizing, stop losses, exposure limits, drawdown monitoring

scanner.description: Market radar — pump.fun monitoring, new token alerts, breakout detection

onchain.description: Blockchain investigator — wallet tracking, contract analysis, liquidity checks

mentor.description: Reflection coach — reads other agents' sessions and authors reusable skills for them

signal_handlers.name: any-buy-to-analyst
signal_handlers.task_template: A {strategy} BUY signal just fired for {symbol} at ${price}. Run a multi-timeframe TA (1h + 4h + 1d) and tell me whether you'd validate this — what's your independent technical read? Be honest if it looks like noise.

signal_handlers.name: any-sell-to-analyst
signal_handlers.task_template: A {strategy} SELL signal just fired for {symbol} at ${price}. Run a multi-timeframe TA and tell me whether the trend break is real or this is a fakeout.

signal_handlers.name: high-confidence-buy-to-risk-manager
signal_handlers.task_template: A high-confidence BUY signal arrived for {symbol} at ${price} from {strategy}. Check current portfolio exposure via get_positions and size a position assuming 1.5% risk per trade and ATR-based stops. Tell me the recommended quantity, stop, and target.

signal_handlers.name: auto-execute-clucmay-buy
signal_handlers.task_template: AUTOTRADE: a clucmay02 BUY signal fired for {symbol} at ${price}. Place a paper-trade BUY order using the place_order tool with a conservative size (start with 0.1 of the position the risk-manager would normally recommend). Use ATR-based stop and 2x take-profit. Confirm in your reply with the order details.

signal_handlers.name: ai-token-analyzer-to-chat
signal_handlers.template: [bold magenta][ai-analyzer][/] {symbol} — see eval_results for the full report
